name: comp-100
blurb: Three horizontal lines animate into an X when clicked.
description: A stateful button component that toggles a hamburger menu icon to an X. Uses SVG paths with transform animations and aria labels for accessibility.
use_when: You need a responsive hamburger menu toggle with clear state indication.
avoid_when: You need keyboard-only navigation or if animation could distract from content.
a11y: Uses aria-expanded and aria-label to communicate state and purpose to screen readers.
